request.description: Better Auth's own route (not a custom controller). Creates a User with role=CLIENT by default and auto-creates a Client profile.
Sets a session cookie automatically — Postman keeps cookies per domain, so subsequent requests in this collection will be authenticated.
Our own lightweight check — requires requireAuth, returns id/email/role/emailVerified.
